name: fn_set_invincible
description: Set whether the player is invincible.

name: fn_configure_player
description: Configure a player using an integer number of lives, a floating point movement speed, and a boolean invincibility setting.

name: fn_configure_multiplayer
description: Configure a player using an integer health value, a floating point movement speed, and a boolean multiplayer setting.

name: fn_set_door_locked
description: Set whether a door is locked.

name: fn_set_enemy_hostile
description: Set whether an enemy is hostile.

name: fn_configure_enemy
description: Configure an enemy using an integer health value, a floating point movement speed, and a boolean hostile setting.

name: fn_add_integers
description: Add two integers together and return their sum.

name: fn_add_floats
description: Add two floating point numbers together and return their sum.
